title: Empty-oracle simulation
statement: Let $M$ be an oracle machine with $k$ ordinary work tapes, let $c$ be a configuration with $k+1$ work tapes, and let $t\in\mathbb{N}$. Running the plain machine obtained from $M$ by eliminating its oracle for $t$ steps from $c$ yields the same configuration as running $M$ for $t$ steps from $c$ with the empty language as oracle.
hypotheses_covered: An oracle machine $M$ with $k$ ordinary work tapes
replaced:
Let $M$ be an oracle machine with $k$ ordinary work tapes, let $c$ be a
configuration with $k+1$ work tapes, and let $t \in \mathbb{N}$.  Running the
plain machine obtained from $M$ by the empty-oracle elimination for $t$ steps
from $c$ yields exactly the configuration obtained by running $M$ for $t$
steps from $c$ relative to the empty oracle.
